newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Micrel estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Micrel estimates raised.

text.p: Robertson, Stephens & Co said its analyst Elias Moosa has raised earnings estimates for Micrel Inc, a maker of semiconducors, to $1.37 a share from $1.24 for full year 1997 and to $1.67 from $1.50 for 1998.
-- Moosa also raised his 1997 revenue estimate to $98 million from $89 million and 1998 to $120 million from $112 million.
-- in a statement, Moosa said the company has "excellent momentum" in its order backlog and "visibility appears clear and continues to build."
-- Micrel shares were up 2-7/8 to 52-7/8 by midday.
